source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original 1647 first edition Wellcome b30338724

source_groups.source_group: Unnumbered seventh house, men's marriage indicators and differentiated marriage targets

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: The seventh House and Judgments appertaining unto it
clauses.historical_meaning_only: A separate unnumbered seventh-house source begins original PDF621, distinct from printed CXXX on servants.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Of Marriage: and first of Mens Marriages
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The initial marriage rules are explicitly scoped in Lilly's period text to men; they are not a universal sex-neutral model.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: in the Marriages of Men Venus and Moon principally
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly names Venus and Moon as principal indicators for men's marriages, prior to assessing house factors.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: seventh House and Lord thereof
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The seventh house and its ruler form a further distinct class of alleged indicators.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Planet or Planets posited in seventh
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Planetary occupants of seventh are a separate class of marriage indicators.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: judge nature and quality ... concerning a Wife
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source claims seventh-house occupants could describe a spouse's character and qualities, unsupported on actual people.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Dowry and other circumstances concerning a Wife
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author additionally proposes estimating a future wife's dowry or circumstances; no confirmed spouse/asset records.

source_groups.source_group: Barren Venus/Moon signs and cadent or eighth house as first no-marriage branch

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Whether Native shall marry a Wife yea or no
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly poses the existence of marriage as the outcome, separate from ease/timing of obtaining a spouse.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: pose with judgement all Significators how affected
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author instructs weighing all marriage indicators, not Venus or Moon placement alone.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: principally Venus and Moon
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Venus and Moon are singled out as primary factors for alleged bachelorhood, while other testimony still matters.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: both these Planets be in barren Signes
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The first negative rule requires both Venus and Moon in traditionally barren signs.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Virgo Gemini Leo
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The original supplies these three signs as barren in this context, with other categories elsewhere.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: also in cadent houses six nine twelve
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source requires specified difficult houses in addition to barren signs for its main negative branch.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: eighth though not cadent admitted for malignancy
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly explicitly adds eighth house although it is not cadent, preventing a simplistic cadent-only transcription.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: single life or averseness from Marriage
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source states alternative subjective aversion or factual single life, broadening possible outcomes.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: other Significators concur sterile signs and cadent
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly says additional agreeing indicators strengthen the negative verdict; the conjunction is not independent replication.

source_groups.source_group: Strong Saturn plus weak Venus/Moon, and explicit stronger-luminaries counterexample

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: either Moon or Venus weak or little fortified
clauses.historical_meaning_only: An adverse additional branch starts from weakness in either primary marriage indicator.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: besides that conjoyned Saturn he very potent
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source requires a strong Saturn conjoined with the relevant indicator, not merely Saturn in the chart.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus herself no support of any Planet by good aspect
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Venus lacking helpful aspects is an additional modifier.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in barren Sign
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Moon barren sign is a separate adverse alternative in the compound passage.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or cadent house
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Moon in cadent house is another alternative to barren sign in that line.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or extremely afflicted
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Moon extreme affliction appears as yet another alternative, with unclear grouping scope.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: no Marriage or any desire thereunto
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly combines factual marriage absence with lack of desire, outcomes needing separate observations.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn ought to be very strong
clauses.historical_meaning_only: In the continuation Lilly explicitly makes the negative rule dependent on very strong Saturn.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: if Venus and Moon more fortified than Saturn judgement holds not true
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author explicitly rules out the negative conclusion when Venus and Moon outrank Saturn in strength.

source_groups.source_group: Elevated Saturn, singleness, claimed chastity/sexual behavior classification

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn more elevated than either Moon or Venus
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Another claimed singleness condition requires Saturn more elevated than the marriage indicators.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: no Planet assisting either of them
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Absence of assisting aspects to Venus or Moon is an additional qualifier.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: his elevation equivalent to a Square
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly describes elevation as equivalent to a square in this context, not simply a literal square.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon and Venus signifie Legitimate Marriages
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author assigns these two planets to legal marriage and alleged desire for married life.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn author of Monkery and Solitarinesse
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Saturn is associated with solitude/monasticism as a period symbolic stereotype.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: either or both extremely impedited of Saturn
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source says Saturn must obstruct Venus or Moon to remove alleged inclination toward marriage.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Concubines and private Sweet hearts ... Venus aspect Saturn Mars
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author asserts different relationships or affairs from Venus aspects to Saturn/Mars; this is not evidence of real sexual behavior.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: being all peregrine or weak
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The concubine claim further requires weak/peregrine planetary condition, not simply any Venus–Mars aspect.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: no good aspect of Sun or Moon
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lack of solar/lunar positive aspect further qualifies the claimed extra-marital affair pattern.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Jupiter Mercury argue Chastity
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly assigns virtue/chastity to a separate planet trio without objective measures.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus and Mars Impudency and Lust
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author ascribes promiscuity or lust to Venus/Mars, a historical sexual stereotype, not modern assessment.

source_groups.source_group: Repeated other significators, no-marriage multi-planet aspects and exact-sign counterbranches

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: other Significators of Marriage also examined
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly repeats that independent natal factors must be checked before concluding permanent singleness.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: other Significators barren Signes or cadent houses
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Additional barren/cadent indicators may reinforce first negative testimony.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: or weak and much afflicted
clauses.historical_meaning_only: These other indicators can instead be weak/afflicted as an alternative strengthening factor.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: in Square with Saturn he well fortified
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source adds a strongly placed Saturn in hard aspect to indicators, not a simple Saturn-only negative.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native will then never Marry
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly asserts a categorical no-marriage verdict under the multiple agreeing sources, without actual follow-up.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in Scorpio in Square of Saturn
clauses.historical_meaning_only: A specific zodiac-plus-Saturn configuration is given as another lifelong-singleness candidate.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in Leo or Taurus
clauses.historical_meaning_only: That Scorpio Moon square aspect is paired with Saturn in specific signs, not all Saturn placements.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Combust of Sun
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author proposes Moon under Sun's beams/combustion as a different negative case.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in Square or Opposition to Saturn
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The combust Moon case additionally invokes a Saturn square/opposition.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn in Capricorn Aquarius or Libra
clauses.historical_meaning_only: This rule names specific signs for Saturn, a qualification of the combusta Moon negative case.

source_groups.source_group: Explicit exception for Moon/Saturn square or opposition alone

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Opposition of Venus and Saturn or Square helps single life
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly frames hard Venus–Saturn aspects as contributory rather than sufficient for singleness.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon barren Signe and cadent house
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Additional moon sign/house affliction is cited beside the hard aspects.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: other significators unhappily in bad houses or unfruitfull Signes
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly specifies other supporting testimony for the negative, not only the Moon/Saturn pair.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon Square or Opposition Saturn not so strong signification
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly explicitly cautions that Moon square/opposition Saturn alone lacks enough force.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: without many other testimonies
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The absence of many supporting indicators invalidates the categorical single-life judgment.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: no although Venus her self barren Signe
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Even Venus in a barren sign is not enough in the stated Moon–Saturn situation without more evidence.

source_groups.source_group: Signs of Marriage positive fecundity, angle houses and seventh rulers

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signes of Marriage
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The original turns from denial of marriage to affirmative signs within the same unnumbered introduction.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Signe of seventh a prolificall Signe
clauses.historical_meaning_only: A fecund seventh-house sign is named as one positive historical indicator.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord thereof fortunate
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly adds a fortunate seventh-house ruler as another affirmative source.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planet in seventh
clauses.historical_meaning_only: A benefic occupant in seventh house is a further distinct positive witness.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus and Moon in fecund Signes
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Both Venus and Moon in fecund signs are mentioned as a positive counterpart to both in barren signs.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: in fifth first eleventh or tenth houses
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The source names four houses for favorable Moon/Venus placement in its positive marriage case.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ascendant applying Lord seventh
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Application from the Ascendant ruler to seventh ruler is proposed as another sign of seeking marriage.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: also equall Reception betwixt them
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Reception between first and seventh lords is a distinct or supporting positive condition.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Native will desire Marriage
clauses.historical_meaning_only: One source outcome is motivation/desire to marry, not necessarily the eventual legal marriage.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: assured testimonies abilities and potency to Venerious acts
clauses.historical_meaning_only: The author additionally infers sexual ability, an unsupported private physiological/sexual claim.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: these configurations or major part concurring
clauses.historical_meaning_only: As with negative testimony, the author uses a majority rather than strictly all positive conditions.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: they argue Native will marry
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Lilly asserts an eventual marriage outcome under the favorable configurations, not verified by any prospective cohort.

source_groups.source_group: Following printed CXXXI obtaining wife ease/difficulty, navigation only

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXXI Whether Native shall obtaine Wife with ease or much difficulty
clauses.historical_meaning_only: A separate printed numbered chapter begins after divider mid original PDF623 and concerns difficulty, not marriage occurrence.

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: greater part of Marriage Significators fortunate
clauses.historical_meaning_only: Only the opening clause of CXXXI is retained to confirm the physical seam; no ease-of-marriage source accepted here.
